method_card.mechanism: Independently parse the raw deposited mmCIF with Biopython and reproduce each assigned atom mapping and chain-pair fit in one reviewer-owned Job.
method_card.objective: Compare the frozen original measurements with independent proper least-squares SVD fits.
method_card.estimator: Bio.SVDSuperimposer and NumPy LAPACK SVD; compare all fitted RMSDs and unsigned rotations under the frozen reproduction tolerances.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Deterministic coordinate analysis; no learned weights or training data.

manifest.licence: The deposited data carry CC0-1.0. The Chaperone metric precedent carries MIT.
manifest.limitations: Single deposited TL1A crystal model 2RE9, label entity 1, chains A/B/C. Monomer mapping and relative rotations describe observed coordinates. No solution assembly, binding or functional estimates.
